domains.name: Official Cause and Manner
domains.summary: Person declaring the official cause and manner of death, agreement between autopsy and death certificate.

domains.name: Case Referral and Scene Investigation
domains.summary: Whether the case was referred to another entity, completion status of scene recreation with or without doll, photos, and witness interviews.

domains.name: Scene Documentation
domains.summary: Completion status of scene recreation with or without doll, photos, and witness interviews.

domains.name: CPS Actions
domains.summary: Whether CPS actions such as terminating parental rights or offering voluntary services were taken.

domains.name: Autopsy and Specialist Consultation
domains.summary: Whether an autopsy was performed, if a specialist was consulted during the autopsy process.

domains.name: SUIDI Completion
domains.summary: Completion status of SUIDI (Sudden Unexpected Infant Death Investigation) and whether it was shared with review team.

domains.name: Toxicology Screen Results
domains.summary: Assessment of toxicology screen results for various substances including alcohol, cocaine, marijuana, methamphetamine, opioids, over-the-counter drugs, prescription drugs, and other substances.

domains.name: Medical Causes of Death
domains.summary: Primary cause of death from medical causes such as cancer, cardiovascular issues, congenital anomalies, infections, respiratory conditions, and pneumonia.
